function: MIMO symbol detection: a DNN (AIDETECT) recovers the transmitted 16-QAM symbol vector from the received signal and the channel matrix (p. 3).
system: Nt x Nr MIMO (2x4, 4x8, 4x4), Rayleigh fading, 16-QAM, perfect CSI at receiver; no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 2-4).
method: DNN with three hidden layers (64, 32, 16 neurons), trained on generated symbols, channels and noise at specific SNR points; paradigm not named, implicitly supervised (pp. 1, 3).
data_channel: Synthetic data from y = Hs + n with Rayleigh fading channels, 16-QAM and AWGN; no standardized or measured channel, no public dataset (p. 3).
test_conditions: Same Rayleigh model for training and testing; MIMO sizes 2x4, 4x8, 4x4, SNR 0-20 dB; no cross-condition test; re-training needed for new channel statistics (pp. 3-4).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE, Neumann Series, Gauss-Seidel, Conjugate Gradient. Learned: DetNet, OAMP-Net-2, LISA, VAE-DNN-Det (pp. 2, 4).
metrics: Symbol error rate, bit error rate, new vector error rate (VER) versus SNR; number of FLOPs for complexity (pp. 1, 3-5).
complexity: Table I lists FLOPs of each detector; AIDETECT is the sum over layers of N(n-1)N(n) neuron products; no measured runtime (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 3: "Rayleigh fading channel model between Nt and Nr" (custom Rayleigh simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured channel is mentioned).
q2_support: p. 3: "the AIDETECT technique will require re-training" (for different channel statistics; no test in a configuration or channel not used for training is reported).
q3_support: p. 3: "better performance than the MMSE"; p. 4: "including DetNet [11], OAMPNet-2" (non-learned MMSE and NS on SER, Fig. 2; earlier learned DetNet, OAMP-Net-2, LISA, VAE-DNN-Det on BER and VER, Fig. 4).
q4_support: p. 5: "number flops is summarized in Table I" (Table I gives the FLOPs expression of AIDETECT and of every baseline).
q5_support: p. 3: "we generate the data from the system model Eq. 3" (own synthetic data; no link, no code or data release, no public dataset).
notes: Published IEEE Communications Letters version. The text layer of Table I holds only its caption, so the AIDETECT FLOPs row was read from the image of p. 5. Learned detectors are compared only for 4x4 (Fig. 4); 2x4 and 4x8 compare conventional detectors. Perfect CSI assumed; imperfect CSI is future work (p. 5).
